directive.thread_id: launch-video port 2026-11-04, models-research lane, slice small-models

targets.baseline_commit_message: Close the open tie lines: device, model cache, stores and checkouts the place reports

preserve: one frame-tool run per video with all its times
frames taken in sorted order, sheets left out, copied as <index:03d>.png in sample order
a video whose run fails is reported and skipped
allowed_deltas: its fixed paths, model names, prompts and words of the person became request fields, read with the person's list:settings row under them (read-data/place.py request)
one JSON line out ({ result } or { error }) instead of a file written beside the script; print lines kept
banned_substitutions: a person's path, model list, vocabulary or question written in code
a second settings reader beside tools/settings
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
